author: homelab
name: Suricata alert (non-scan) — possible active exploit
description: Port of Wazuh 100001: Suricata alerts except ET SCAN / ET POLICY / Zmap / zgrab / masscan / network-scan category / Informational signatures.
query: suricata.eve.event_type:alert AND NOT rule.name:(ET\ SCAN* OR ET\ POLICY* OR *Zmap* OR *zgrab* OR *masscan*) AND NOT rule.category:"Detection of a Network Scan" AND NOT suricata.eve.alert.metadata.signature_severity:Informational
